units.translation: 651. 〈φέρον: supply〉 ταύτην. Sm
4 πρ-οῦ in W : -όν

656-63a. The sense: just as a bride, given in marriage by her parents and brothers, when her husband has perished by some fate before they could enjoy each other, burning in her soul with grief, weeps in her chamber, ashamed even before her maidservants, lest any of the women who approach should mock her. L
18 τῇ ἐντροπῇ in Fr. : τὴν -ήν
b. 〈θαάσσει:〉 she sits. Lg
c. 〈χήρον:〉 desolate. Lg
d. ἐπιστοβέωσι: they mock, revile, blame. LmP

22 Et. Gen. (AB) ἐπιστοβέωσι: III 663 (B, om. A). ἐπιστομέωσι and by change of μ to β 〈ἐπιστοβέωσι add. W〉. Thus Apollonius, the author of the Argonautica (thus sqq. B, om. A). Et. M. 385, 19 sch. IV 1725
22 χλευάζωσι in GsSm with the rest omitted : -ωσι in P : -ζουσαι in L
665. ἐπιπρομολοῦσα: the preposition ἐπί is redundant. LmP
23 P adds at the end ὡς ἐν τῷ ‘ἐπιβουκόλος’ (Hom.), cf. W 43
666. ἐπέτις: a young attendant. LmP
668. 〈ἀρέσασθαι:〉 to persuade. Lg
25 πεῖσαι in W : -ειν
676. θευμορίη: a disease allotted by the gods ran through. Lm (P)
680. 〈ἵνα:〉 where. Lg
687. ἐπεκλονέεσκον: they were stirring up. LgP
688-89a. 〈περί μοι παίδων:〉 my soul is troubled on account of your sons, lest their father kill them along with the strangers. Lm (P)
b. μή σφε: lest them; for it is by elision from σφέας.
3 ἐκ in P : om. L
690. 〈νέον:〉 recently. Lg
694. ἀντιάσειε: he would entreat, supplicate. Lm (P)
5 δυσ-ειε in H : -ει in L : differently in P
699-700. 〈ὅττι τοι εἴπω:〉 whatever I tell you, keep it in your soul and become a helper.
714. 〈Κόλχων ὅρκος:〉 that the oath of the Colchians is Uranus and Earth.
8 ὁ τῶν instead of ὅτι in H
724-26. ἀνέπτατο χάρματι θυμός: her soul took relief, being in joy. And plausibly he characterizes love for us.
730-31. 〈εἰ ἔτι σῆς:〉 if I should prefer anything of you or of your children. Lm
732. 〈κηδεμόνες:〉 those who care for one another. Lg

738a. οἴσομαι εἰς Ἑκά〈της〉: in some copies after “οἴσομαι εἰς Ἑκάτης θελκτήρια φάρμακα ταύρων” another line is found: “οἰσομένη ξείνῳ, οὗπερ τόδε νεῖκος ὄρωρε.” But in some it is not found, as also here. L
17 οὗπερ in W : εἴπερ in L : ὑπὲρ οὗ in F
b. 〈θελκτήρια:〉 remedies. Lg
740-41. 〈παισί τ’ ἀρωγήν:〉 Chalciope explained to her children the things agreed upon by Medea. Lm
21 αὑτῆς in Hoelzlin : αὐ-
742. στυγερὸν δέος: by metonymy he said “that which causes fear.”
743. τοῖα παρέξ οὗ πατρός: such things to plan for Jason without the knowledge of her father.
745. Ἑλίκην: the Great Bear. LgP
748. ἀδινόν: instead of ἀδινῶς. Supply θρηνοῦσαν. LgP
750. μελαινομένην: darkened, that is, moonless. Lg (P)
